declarations.name: PdxWizard
declarations.description:
A multi-step wizard with a stepper header, back/next navigation in linear or free mode, and a
validation guard before moving on.

members.name: goTo
members.description: Go to a step by index. Returns false, and moves nothing, when the step is not reachable yet or a `pdx-before-change` listener cancels.

members.name: goNext
members.description: The next step, through the same guards as `goTo`; false at the last one.

members.name: goPrev
members.description: The previous step, through the same guards as `goTo`; false at the first one.

members.name: complete
members.description: Emit `pdx-complete` for the step in view. It does not advance, validate or close anything.
